verdict.rationale: Wave is double-entry accounting software, so drafting and posting journal entries via an API into an accountant review queue is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack does not document this. The developer portal, noted as the home of a GraphQL API, returned 403 and could not be quoted. The public pages document no API surface, no journal-entry endpoint and no draft or review-queue workflow. Accountant access roles are a separate feature and do not count as a review queue.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent draft and post journal entries via the API and leave them in a review queue for my accountant
